result.summary: The environment is dominated by high-speed vehicle infrastructure, featuring a wide slip lane and a lack of dedicated sidewalks. While a crosswalk is marked, the absence of pedestrian signals and physical separation from traffic creates a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: High-speed slip lane
hazards.description: The wide radius of the right-turn slip lane allows vehicles to maintain high speeds while crossing the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalks
hazards.description: No paved sidewalks are visible, forcing pedestrians to walk on the road shoulder or unpaved grass.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and parked cars near the crossing may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Slip Lane Removal or Tightening
interventions.description: Reduce the turn radius or eliminate the slip lane to slow turning vehicles and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the channelized area to provide a safe waiting space for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, multi-lane roadway with visible traffic signals but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The pavement is in poor condition, and the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire width of the asphalt roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven road surface can cause tripping or affect vehicle braking performance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and timing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, lacking basic infrastructure such as sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or traffic control devices. Pedestrians are forced to share a wide, poorly maintained roadway with vehicles, creating significant safety risks.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: No dedicated space for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the road throughout the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Undefined Roadway Width
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings and excessive width can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear on the asphalt surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection to define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Use paint and bollards or permanent curbs to narrow the travel lanes, reducing vehicle speeds and crossing distances.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poorly defined, featuring a faded crosswalk and a lack of functional sidewalks amidst dense roadside vegetation. While a traffic signal is present, the overall infrastructure is degraded, offering minimal protection or guidance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The area where a pedestrian would wait or walk is broken and uneven, posing a trip hazard.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk is barely visible, reducing driver awareness of the crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals for pedestrians are visible at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with bold, continental markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install signals with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and clarity.
